Question B-001-022-002.

Why the correct answer is right: The NOT-correct statement is exemption from portions of the exam; the bank supports accommodation in delivery, not skipping required portions.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "A disabled candidate, taking a Morse code sending test, may be allowed to recite the examination text in Morse code sounds": This changes how the Morse sending test is performed; it does not exempt the candidate from the test.
- sourceIndex 2: "Examinations for disabled candidates may be given orally, or tailored to the candidate's ability to complete the examination": This is an accommodation to the examination format so the candidate can complete it.
- sourceIndex 3: "After passing the basic exam, a disabled candidate may take the other exams in any order": The order rule for later qualifications still applies after Basic and is not an exam-portion exemption.
